name: browser-use
headline: ccpet: Enhance Your Status Line
short_description: ccpet is a virtual pet that lives in your Claude Code status line. It provides a fun, visual indicator of your agent's status. Operations teams can use it to monitor agent health and activity in real-time.
author: terryso

sections.overview: The ccpet skill introduces a unique and engaging feature to your Claude Code status line by adding a virtual pet. This automation skill allows users to personalize their coding environment, making it more enjoyable and interactive. By integrating a virtual pet, developers can bring a touch of fun to their workflow while maintaining focus on their tasks. The implementation of this skill is straightforward, requiring approximately 30 minutes to set up, making it accessible even for those with intermediate technical skills. One of the key benefits of using ccpet is the enhancement of user engagement during coding sessions. While the time savings are not explicitly defined, the skill can lead to increased productivity by providing a lighthearted distraction that can help alleviate stress. By incorporating this playful element, developers may find themselves more motivated and less prone to burnout, which is essential in a demanding tech environment. This skill is particularly suited for developers, product managers, and AI practitioners who are looking to add a creative touch to their workflows. Teams that prioritize a positive work culture and seek to improve morale may find ccpet beneficial. For example, a software development team could use this skill during long coding sprints to foster a more enjoyable atmosphere, potentially leading to better collaboration and innovative ideas. With an intermediate complexity level, ccpet requires users to have a basic understanding of Claude Code and its automation capabilities. It seamlessly fits into AI-first workflows by providing an engaging interface that can be integrated into daily tasks. As organizations increasingly adopt AI automation, skills like ccpet can help humanize technology, making it more relatable and enjoyable for users. Explore the potential of ccpet and enhance your coding experience on Shyft.ai.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/terryso/ccpet`
sections.usage:
```
Create a ccpet virtual pet for my Claude Code status line. The pet should be a [ANIMAL] that changes its appearance based on the agent's status. For example, when idle, it should [IDLE_ACTION], and when working, it should [WORK_ACTION]. The pet should also [ADDITIONAL_FEATURE] to make it more engaging.
```
